chose: The record's shape. A turn is the spoken card's turn (a line Kokoro says, or the owner's take by home's id) with an id that lasts across versions; a segue is one of the agent's turns, not a field on the owner's, since it is the agent's voice and the agent's editorial work. A flag goes only on a turn of the newest version, in the voice its kind belongs to, and the owner may take it back until the next version. The next version answers every open flag, each once, and says how, from a table keyed by the flag's kind: a rewrite names every turn it changed (added, removed, reworded or moved), which the record checks against the two versions and which may reach past the flagged turn; a retake plays a take the owner gave as a new point; conditioning plays the take louder, faster or slower (HOST12); and any flag may be kept, with a reason the owner reads. A green light goes only to the newest version with no flag open, and closes the record: the signature is a record of its own, keyed by the green-lit version's turn ids, and a reopened conversation is a new record or a new event in /2.
options: Segues as agent turns; every open flag answered, keeping it allowed with a reason; the green light closes the record (chosen)
